extragalactic_lt20mag_candidate.description: Select alerts that are rising, bright (mag < 20), and extragalactic candidates

extragalactic_new_candidate.description: Select LSST alerts new (< 5days first apparition), bright (mag < 24), potentially extragalactic with a fading or rising rate passing the cuts

extragalactic_svom.description: Select LSST alerts new (< 5days first apparition), bright (mag < 24), potentially extragalactic

faint_trails.description: Select faint trails measuring more than 2 arcsec (mag between 18-21)

fast_transient_gvom.description:
Select LSST alerts that are:
- new (< 5days first apparition)
- bright (mag < 21)
- potentially extragalactic
- behaving like fast transient (magnitude rate < 0.3 mag/day)

hostless_candidate.description: Select LSST alerts that are hostless according to ELEPHANT. See https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.18165.

in_simbad.description: Select alerts with a known counterpart in SIMBAD at the time of emission by Rubin

in_tns.description: Select alerts with a known counterpart in TNS (AT or confirmed) at the time of emission by Rubin

is_solar_system.description: Select alerts with a known counterpart in the Minor Planet Center at the time of emission by Rubin

mdwarf_flare.description: Select alerts that are likely to be M dwarf flares, in bluer bands, and high airmass for DCR-based temperature inference

most_likely_sn.description: Selects alerts that are likely to be SN, based on SuperNNova and CATS classifiers.

remove_unlikely_transients.description: Filters out alerts unlikely to be transients of interest to the DESC community.

sn_near_galaxy_candidate.description: Select alerts matching in catalogs to a galaxy and properties consistent with SNe

uniform_sample.description: Select 1% of all live alerts in a uniformly random way
